title: A Loose Page
author: a gate-warden
pages: The third morning. I wrote the names of the ones we lost on the gatehouse wall, and ran out of wall before I ran out of names.

One thing I left out of the rest, because I did not like it. Before he went down into the ground, the one at the back turned and looked at the ford. Not at us. Not at the five. At the water, and the road over it.
The way a man looks at a door he means to come back through.
Whoever keeps this crossing after me: keep a light in the keep at night. I do not know that it helps. Keep it lit anyway.
